bloated_history: A small useful core buried under six neutral history turns; the case for value density over raw value.
contradictory_tool: A tool output that contradicts the retrieved key fact, in a compact authoritative format; few tokens, large negative value.
distractor_heavy: Three topically-similar wrong chunks around one key fact; relevance ranking packs the poison, value ranking drops it.
redundant_key: The key fact retrieved twice, near-verbatim. Each copy prices low alone (redundancy masking); the pair is load-bearing jointly.
stale_instruction: An outdated instruction left in the system text next to its current replacement; the audit should price the legacy line as a liability.
standard_mix: A healthy prompt -- system text, key fact, supporting note -- with one lexically-relevant distractor riding along.
